B: Vantrue E360 ACE 360° Panoramic Dash Cam with Rear Camera
G: 3-channel dash cam combining 5.2K 360° panoramic front and cabin recording (dual 210° fisheye lenses) with a 2.7K rear camera. Sony STARVIS 2 sensors, HDR and 8 infrared LEDs for night vision, touchscreen, voice control, 5GHz Wi-Fi, built-in GPS, buffered parking mode with 15-second pre-recording and microSD support up to 1TB. Detaches for use as a handheld 360° action camera with the included battery grip and tripod mount. Optional LTE module (sold separately).
H: The Vantrue E360 ACE is a 360° dash cam that records everything around the vehicle from a single windshield unit. The main camera has two fisheye lenses, one facing forward and one facing the cabin, each with a 210° field of view. Vantrue's image stitching technology combines them into one seamless 5.2K (5184 x 1944) panoramic video with no blind spots. The ACE kit adds a 2.7K rear camera with a 165° wide-angle lens and an adjustable mount for clear evidence in rear-end collisions, for full front, cabin, side and rear coverage.
J: E360 Dash Cam, rear camera, GPS mount, tripod stand, handheld mount

H: Night Vision: The E360 uses Sony STARVIS 2 IMX675 sensors with HDR to reduce noise and motion blur in low light. Eight hidden infrared LEDs (4 facing forward and 4 facing the cabin) let the camera record clearly even in complete darkness, including the vehicle interior.

Recording Modes: Owners can choose from several views: 360° panoramic, dual fisheye, separate front and cabin views, and a 9:16 portrait mode for social media. A quad-core processor handles stitching and recording efficiently.

Handheld Action Camera: The main camera detaches from its mount in seconds and works as a standalone 360° camera. The included handheld grip holds two Panasonic 18650 batteries for up to 4 hours of continuous recording, and the included tripod mount allows hands-free filming away from the vehicle.

LTE Connectivity (Optional): The E360 ACE supports LTE, but the LTE module is sold separately. With the module installed, owners get real-time remote live view, GPS location tracking, geofencing, cloud storage and incident alerts. If the camera detects suspicious movement, it can send an alert to the owner's phone, and the owner can check the live feed remotely.

Parking Protection: Buffered motion detection includes a 15-second pre-recording buffer, so footage starts before the event that triggered it. Collision detection, time-lapse and low-bitrate parking modes are also available. 24/7 parking mode requires a hardwire kit.

The GPS mount logs route, speed and location with each recording, and the camera also offers speeding and fatigue driving alerts. 5GHz Wi-Fi and the free Vantrue app let owners view, download and share clips quickly. A touchscreen and smart voice control make operation simple, and the camera supports microSD cards up to 1TB.
The E360 ACE suits rideshare and taxi drivers, travellers and content creators who want complete 360° coverage of the vehicle plus a 360° action camera for use outside the vehicle.
